theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mass_measure_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → (∃ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ) ∧ ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → ∃ ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k, StronglyMeasurable ξ ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∑ α : SimonMultiIndex k P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (ξ x) α) ^ 2 = 1) ∧ IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
